# Fog light bulb upgrades

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove the bumper access panel and swap halogen or LED bulbs by prying off the lens. [t1859]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the small access panel located on the bottom of the stock bumper.
2. Take out the 10mm bolt that secures the assembly in place.
3. Push the two metal pins at the top left and right with a Phillips head screwdriver to dislodge them from their retaining clips.
4. [Partial] Lift the foglight assembly forward until it flops out of the front bumper.
5. Disconnect the wiring harness connector.
6. [Partial] If replacing a halogen, twist the back cover counter clockwise to expose the bulb socket.
7. Release the tension clip on the bulb and pull off the single spade connector.
8. [Partial] For new halogens, handle the glass carefully or wear gloves before reinstalling it into the socket.
9. [Partial] Popping the assembly back in place if only replacing a burned-out bulb.
10. [Partial] If installing an LED, remove the two small Phillips head screws located on either side of the housing near the mud line.
11. [Partial] Slowly heat the rear edge of the lens where it meets the housing with a heat gun to soften the seal.
12. Pry the heated lens off using a flathead screwdriver.
13. Remove the single Phillips head screw holding the internal reflector cap in place and discard the cap.
14. [Partial] Lay a small bead of OSI Quad adhesive over the existing factory glue on the bulb or socket area.
15. Press the lens back onto the housing, applying heat if necessary to re-soften the seal.
16. Screw the two small Phillips head screws back into the sides of the housing.
17. Slide the foglight assembly back into its position in the bumper.
18. Reconnect the wiring harness connector.
19. Tighten the 10mm bolt securing the assembly again.
20. Replace the access panel on the bottom of the bumper.

_Procedure reported by [t1859]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-replace-gen-1-5-h3-foglight-bulb-w-led-upgrade-goodness.4542/>_

## Specifications

- **Bolt size**: 10mm [t1859] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Bulb type (Stock)**: H3 or 880/899 [t1859] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use a heat gun to soften factory glue when reinstalling the lens. [t1859]
- [Partial] Apply OSI Quad adhesive over existing glue before pressing the lens back on. [t1859]
- [Partial] Use a heat gun to slowly warm the back side of the lens where it meets the housing. [t1859]
- Pry off the lens gently with a flathead screwdriver. [t1859]
